title: Read-only audit of 144Ba/146Ba E1-E3 evidence and SCCM model boundaries

claims.claim: The quoted reduced E3 matrix element is conventionally reported for 0+ -> 3-, while the quoted downward B(E3) is for 3- -> 0+.
claims.evidence: BU16 reports M(E3)=0.65(+0.17/-0.23) eb^(3/2) and B(E3;3- -> 0+)=48(+25/-34) W.u.; BU17 reports the analogous 146Ba values.
claims.locator: BU16-D26-001; BU17-D26-005; BU16 PDF p.4 Table I; BU17 PDF pp.2-3 Table I
claims.boundary: By the angular-momentum definition, B(E3;0+ -> 3-) = 7 * B(E3;3- -> 0+) for the same reduced matrix element. The factor 7 is a direction convention, not a sevenfold experimental discrepancy.

claims.claim: The 146Ba experimental E1 amplitude 0.000223(+10/-8) and SCCM amplitude 0.00474 are quoted in the same reduced-matrix-element unit eb^(1/2).
claims.evidence: The source audit records the printed Table I amplitude and the SCCM value; their central-value amplitude ratio is about 21.26 and the squared-strength ratio is about 451.8.
claims.locator: BU17-D26-001; BU17 PDF p.3 Table I and following paragraph
claims.boundary: This arithmetic is a unit-consistent comparison of printed central values. It is not an exact model-data validation: the E1 experimental constraint is mainly inherited from prior lifetime/branching data and the complete correlated likelihood is unavailable.

claims.claim: A collective-amplitude F(q) plot is not the transition kernel and cannot by itself predict an absolute E1 or E3 strength.
claims.evidence: Bernard defines F=N^(1/2)f and writes observables as a double coordinate sum f* O(q,q') f; BU17 also uses projected intrinsic-state amplitudes and orbital occupancies.
claims.locator: BE16-D26-005; BU17-D26-004; Bernard PDF p.2 Eqs.4-5
claims.boundary: Similar F(q) densities can coexist with very different odd-parity operator kernels. Signed E1 cancellation requires the projected E1 kernel and coherent HWG amplitudes, not only F(q), v2, or a mean-field minimum.

claims.claim: SCCM values are model calculations and must not be presented as measured observables.
claims.evidence: BU17 directly measures E3 through Coulomb excitation and separately compares with SCCM; Bernard calculates projected-GCM E3 strength (0.460 eb^(3/2), downward B(E3)=25 W.u.).
claims.boundary: Measured B(E3), E1 amplitudes and upper limits belong to the experimental evidence tier. SCCM/Gogny-D1S, rigid-rotor conversions, beta3 values, orbital v2 and calculated D0 signs belong to model or derived tiers.

unresolved_questions: The full GOSIA covariance or joint likelihood for the 146Ba E1/E3 fit is unavailable.
Production SCCM transition kernels and code are unavailable; F-plot similarity cannot be independently converted into an E1 kernel audit.
The relative E1/E3 sign is model or fit dependent and is not an experimentally measured absolute phase.
The available E3 intervals cannot statistically distinguish a rigid static pear shape from dynamic octupole softness without additional observables such as parity-displacement systematics.
audit_mode: read-only; no commit/push; no full-repository lint
